failed_assertions.desc: GND unification: all ground pins across 4 ICs share one common ground net.
3.3V domain unification: regulator output, MCU core/analog/battery supply, sensor supply+IO, and display supply share one power net. CSB excluded (handled separately by ANY-002).

Critical net isolation: GND, VCC_3V3, VIN, I2C SDA, I2C SCL, OSC_IN, OSC_OUT, and NRST must all reside on mutually distinct nets. Uses fixed peripheral-side bus pins so the check is invariant to MCU I2C pin mapping.
Unified ground net must carry Ground electrical attribute.
3.3V rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
5V input rail must carry Power electrical attribute.
I2C bus legal bundle mapping: accept one complete legal SDA/SCL pair of STM32F103 hardware I2C routing. This avoids illegal mixed mappings such as PB7 for SDA with PB8 for SCL.
